user.title: Reolink doorbell
user.description: Doorbell access details. The password is stored only in the Home Assistant configuration.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the doorbell
reconfigure.description: Change the address or credentials. The password is not stored anywhere else.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the doorbell

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different doorbell

data_description.quality: Light uses less data (recommended away from home). High shows more detail.
data_description.preload: Makes the video appear almost instantly, in exchange for a permanent, light connection to the doorbell.
data_description.webrtc: Creates a second camera for WebRTC viewing: the lowest delay, but it only works inside the local network and not on every device (for example not on iPhone with Home Assistant's built-in go2rtc).
